QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: hiddenRestrictions
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Bit mask of the geozone restrictions which are not drawn on maps. Checks and alerts still apply to them.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: altitudeFilter
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Only zones near the flight altitudes
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hide geozones on maps whose floor is more than 100 m above, or whose ceiling is more than 100 m below, the altitude of the active vehicle in the Fly View or the altitudes of the mission in the Plan View. Checks and alerts still apply to them.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: scheduleFilter
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Which geozones maps show by their schedule: all, those active now, those active now or within 12 hours, or those active during the planned flight (from the planned start to the estimated end, or now without a planned start). Checks and alerts still apply to the others.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: All zones,Active now,Active within 12 h,Active at flight time

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: mapSource
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Key of the only geozone source whose zones maps show, empty for all sources. Checks and alerts still apply to the zones of the other sources.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: recordRetention
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Keep alert logs and flight records
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: How long the daily alert logs and the flight records in the telemetry folder are kept. Older files are deleted when a new one is written.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: includeOperatorDetails
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Add the operator ID and the aircraft's ID, type, EU category and class of the Remote ID settings to the exported briefings and operational intents and to the flight records.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: approachExtraDistance
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Meters added to the horizontal distance at which the vehicle is alerted that it approaches a geozone. The manufacturer's alert thresholds for the vehicle type set that distance from its speed, position accuracy, the reaction time, its braking or turning distance, the wind and a safety margin; this only makes the alerts earlier.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: approachExtraTime
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Seconds added to the time before a predicted entry into a geozone at which the vehicle is alerted, and to the approach distances at the current speed and climb rate. The manufacturer's alert thresholds for the vehicle type set the warning time; this only makes the alerts earlier.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: activationCaution
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minutes before a time-limited geozone becomes active at which a vehicle inside it or within its approach distances is cautioned, with the time left.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trafficEnabled
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: List the ADS-B and Remote ID aircraft received by QGroundControl within 10 km of the active vehicle which are in or near active geozones, and show an alert when one enters a zone.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: qnhHPa
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Local sea level pressure (altimeter setting) used to convert geozone limits published as flight levels to approximate heights above mean sea level. 1013.25 hPa is the standard pressure of flight levels.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: feedRefreshHours
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Hours after which downloaded geozone feeds are downloaded again.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: feedCatalogueUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Address of a feed catalogue (GeoZoneFeeds.json format) extending or changing the built-in feeds, like one published by the manufacturer. It is downloaded again with the feeds. Leave empty to use the built-in feeds and the feeds.json file of the geozone data folder only.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: liveFeedRefreshMinutes
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minutes after which feeds of temporary flight restrictions, which change during the day, are downloaded again.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: staleDays
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Age in days after which the data of a geozone source is reported as outdated.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: outdatedInvalid
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Outdated geozone data is shown as expired and uploading a mission asks for confirmation. Its zones are still shown, checked and alerted.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: followAreaOfInterest
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Download services around the mission and vehicle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Download the zones of geozone services taking an area again when the planned mission or the active vehicle leaves the area downloaded.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: followMapView
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Download services for the map view
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Include the area shown on the Fly or Plan map, up to 200 km across, in the area downloaded from geozone services taking an area, a second after the map stops moving.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: packSigningKeyFile
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Ed25519 private key file (PEM) signing the exported offline packs. Packs are exported unsigned without one.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: packPublisherName
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Name given as the publisher of the signed offline packs.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trustedPackPublishers
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Publishers whose signed offline packs are trusted: a JSON array of objects with their name and Ed25519 public key in base64.
